name: zkvm_openvm
description: The OpenVM platform: entry point and memory map

options.note: Elide the RA spill/reload and frame in leaf methods (dotnet-riscv patches 23 and 31). Sound only on a single-threaded deterministic guest with no GC thread suspension and no return-address hijacking.

The decoder has no C extension, and a single-threaded guest needs no atomics: the managed .text stays 32-bit and lock-free (dotnet-riscv fixups 24/25). Check with --error-on-compressed / --error-on-atomic.

Per-site inline allocation (dotnet-riscv fixup 26): the cell of the bump pointer, at a fixed address. It MUST equal g_zk_bump_ptr in the linker script. OpenVM has the full 4 GiB u32 range (MEM_BITS 32 on the develop-v2.1.0 line); its RAM stays up to 0xbfff0000, and the cell is 8 bytes below it.
